programs.title: Lakefront Luxury
programs.desc: Aimee and Sabby love to travel and are on the hunt for a lakefront property that feels like a permanent vacation; they are considering three homes, a rustic 1960s build with a stone fireplace, a modern new build with a sleek kitchen.

programs.title: Lakefront Luxury
programs.desc: Retired couple Janet and Tom search for a lakefront property to enjoy fishing, one of their favorite pastimes. Their hunt leads them to three homes, all with unique amenities.

programs.title: Lakefront Luxury
programs.desc: Empty nesters Froy and Lori are searching for a larger vacation home to accommodate their extended family; they visit a spacious rustic home with a gourmet kitchen and a three-slip dock, a 6000 square foot luxury log home with a hot tub waterfall feature, and a modern home with a temperature-controlled wine display and waterfront views.

programs.title: Lakefront Luxury
programs.desc: Empty nesters Carlo and Cat are looking for a home with amazing lake views, a large kitchen, and space for their dogs; on the hunt for their dream lakefront property, they first view a modern farmhouse with a large kitchen, a games room, a wine cellar and a boathouse; the second house they view is a contemporary home with a chef's kitchen, sauna and a descending trail to the lake; the last home on their tour is a 5-bedroom ranch-style home with lake views, a wine cellar and a movie theater.

programs.title: Restored
programs.desc: Brett helps a woman and her adult children restore their majestic 1913 Mission Revival mansion; he's elated when he realizes he can restore the original linoleum in the kitchen, but the homeowners may not be open to the idea.

programs.title: Restored
programs.desc: Brett is called upon to restore a historically significant 1906 Arts and Crafts home; he brings it back to its original glory by reintroducing the closed-in fireplaces, reinstating the floor plan and replacing the 1980s kitchen.

programs.title: Restored
programs.desc: In Redlands, Calif., Brett restores a 1941 modern ranch for a couple who inherited the home; he modernizes the kitchen and opens up the living and dining room, then he surprises the couple by adding a feature found in the original blueprints.

programs.title: Restored
programs.desc: Brett's clients purchase their first home together, a 1923 Mediterranean Revival, and they want to restore it after years of small updates by the former homeowners; during demolition, Brett discovers the house is suffering from severe termite damage.

programs.title: Restored
programs.desc: Brett helps an engaged couple restore their 1901 neoclassical-Victorian home, including a new kitchen and bathroom; Brett removes additions to create a spacious kitchen, adding original elements to make this the home of the happy couple's dreams.

programs.title: Restored
programs.desc: Brett helps a young family restore their home, which has been in the family for generations, to its architectural glory while simultaneously creating modern functionality.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: A family inherits a generational cabin they love on Sand Pond; along with the camp itself, they inherit a dark and damp building with a dated layout and lots of rot; the "Maine Cabin Masters" hammer, saw and sand their way through an overhaul.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
